$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocompletion and validation.

fallback.description: Browser for unmatched URLs. Accepts a bundle ID (e.g. 'com.brave.Browser'), an app name ('Brave Browser'), or a full .app path.

unwrapSafeLinks.description: Inspect the destination URL inside Microsoft Teams and Outlook safe-links to choose the browser, while still opening the original wrapper URL.

routes.description: Ordered list of routing rules. The first matching route wins.

browser.description: Target browser bundle ID (e.g. 'com.google.Chrome'), app name ('Google Chrome'), or full .app path.

profile.description: Optional browser profile name. For Chromium browsers this is the profile directory name (e.g. 'Default', 'Profile 1'); for Firefox/Zen it is the profile name. Run 'browter profiles' to list installed profiles.

domains.description: Human-friendly domain and path rules: 'example.com' (exact host), '*.example.com' (host and subdomains), '.microsoft' (any host under TLD), 'github.com/org' (host + path prefix).

patterns.description: Case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the full URL.

hints.description: Optional tab-URL substrings used by AppleScript to find an existing Google Chrome window for this profile. Auto-derived from 'domains' when omitted.

useAppleScript.description: When true (default), adds tabs to an already-running Google Chrome window via AppleScript before falling back to spawning Chrome.
